action: No action needed. If mail seems delayed, check the Google Workspace status dashboard and confirm important messages arrived before assuming a wider problem.
exec: User-reported Gmail problems that Google has not confirmed as a broad outage; no sign of a security issue.
plain: Some Gmail users reported trouble sending and receiving email around November 16 and 17. Google says it sees no evidence of a broad disruption, and there is no indication of a cyberattack.
summary: Fox News says Gmail and iCloud had user reliability issues that persisted into Tuesday afternoon, November 17. Google said on X that day it is not seeing evidence of a broad Gmail service disruption, per gagadget.com, which counted more than 2,800 user reports. Cyber cause: not indicated.
title: Gmail users report sending and receiving problems; Google sees no broad disruption

validation.note: Compared Fox live blog (Gmail and iCloud reliability issues into Tuesday afternoon) with gagadget.com (Google's X post of 17 Nov: no evidence of a broad Gmail disruption; more than 2,800 user reports). Removed the Downdetector peak timing and dashboard statement, which neither page states in the form recorded.

review.note: Fox live blog has no dedicated Gmail entry: only a 'what to know' line that Gmail and iCloud had reliability issues into Tuesday afternoon. Downdetector peak timing and Google's 'no evidence of broad disruption' / dashboard statement could not be found on the page.
